bank.module: Session 1 — Relational Databases & Data Modeling for Data Engineers
bank.title: Session 1 — Database Fundamentals, ER Modeling & Relational Mapping — Bank 001

questions.question: An organization needs a structured electronic way to store, manage, retrieve, and manipulate operational information. Which concept from the session best matches this requirement?

explanation.ar: المتطلبات هنا هي نفس وظيفة الـ database في المادة: organized collection of data لدعم storage, management, retrieval, and manipulation.

questions.question: A proposed system allows only one user, loses data after the session ends, and provides no reliability or safety guarantees. Which DBMS objective from the course is most clearly missing?

options.text: Reliable and safe multi-user access to persistent data

explanation.ar: الـ DBMS في المادة مطلوب منه reliable, safe, multi-user storage والوصول لـ persistent data؛ المواصفات المذكورة بتفشل في أكتر من عنصر أساسي.

questions.question: A company wants to reduce duplicate stored values and decrease update inconsistencies. Which database advantage directly addresses this?

options.text: Reduced data redundancy and improved consistency

explanation.ar: تقليل data redundancy بيقلل تكرار نفس البيانات، وده يقلل فرص updating errors ويحسن consistency.

questions.question: Which item is listed as a possible disadvantage of using databases?

options.text: Automatic elimination of all security risks

explanation.ar: المادة بتذكر Complexity وCost وSecurity وCompatibility كعيوب أو تحديات محتملة لاستخدام قواعد البيانات.

questions.question: A designer is deciding how data should be structured, related, constrained, and accessed before building the database. Which artifact is the designer defining?

explanation.ar: الـ Data Model هو اللي بيحدد structure وrelationships وconstraints وطريقة تنظيم والوصول للبيانات قبل التنفيذ.

questions.question: A system stores records in a tree where every record has one parent and can have several children. Which model matches this structure?

explanation.ar: الـ Hierarchical model بينظم البيانات في tree-like structure: كل record له single parent وممكن يكون له multiple children.

questions.question: Which data model in the course is described as supporting many-to-many relationships among database constraints?

explanation.ar: المادة بتوصف الـ Network model بأنه مناسب لتمثيل many-to-many relationships.

questions.question: A system stores flexible semi-structured records such as JSON or XML instead of rigid tables. Which model is being used?

explanation.ar: الـ Document model بيخزن flexible, semi-structured documents زي JSON وXML بدل rigid tables.

questions.question: A Student relation has columns RollNumber, Name, and CGPA. When the row (003, Harsh, 8.5) is examined, what does that row represent in the relational model?

explanation.ar: في relational model الصف الكامل يمثل tuple/record، بينما كل column يمثل attribute.

questions.question: Which statement about the relational model is supported by the course?

options.text: Data is stored in tables and the model supports data independence
Data must be stored only as XML documents
It is used only for object methods and classes
Every record must have multiple parents

explanation.ar: المادة بتذكر إن الـ Relational Model هو الأكثر استخدامًا، البيانات فيه stored in tables، وبيسمح بـ data independence.

questions.question: What is the primary role of the Entity-Relationship (ER) model in this material?

options.text: To represent entities and relationships graphically for relational database design
To replace database tables with XML documents

explanation.ar: الـ ER Model أداة graphical لتصميم relational databases قبل التنفيذ، وبيوضح entities وattributes وrelationships وconstraints.

questions.question: In classic ER notation shown in the course, which shape represents an entity?

explanation.ar: في الـ ER notation المعروضة: Entity = rectangle، Relationship = diamond، Attribute = ellipse.

source.reference: Slide 21 — Entity Relationship Modeling: Key Components

questions.question: In classic ER notation shown in the course, which shape represents a relationship?

explanation.ar: الـ Relationship بيتُمثل بالـ diamond في الـ ER notation المستخدمة في المادة.

source.reference: Slide 21 — Entity Relationship Modeling: Key Components

questions.question: A Customer exists independently in a system, while an Address entity is modeled as dependent on that Customer. How should they be classified?

options.text: Customer is weak; Address is strong
Customer is strong; Address is weak

explanation.ar: Strong Entity بيقدر يوجد بشكل مستقل، بينما Weak Entity وجوده dependent على strong/parent entity.

questions.question: Which is a composite attribute according to the course examples?

options.text: Full Name = First Name + Last Name

explanation.ar: Composite attribute بيتكوّن من أجزاء أصغر، والمثال في المادة Full Name المكوّن من First Name + Last Name.

questions.question: An Age value is calculated from Date of Birth instead of being stored directly. What type of attribute is Age in this example?

explanation.ar: لما قيمة attribute تتحسب من قيمة تانية، زي Age من DOB، فهي Derived attribute.

questions.question: A designer models Employee manages Employee and Supplier supplies Product to Warehouse. Which pair of relationship degrees is correct?

options.text: Unary for Employee manages Employee; ternary for Supplier–Product–Warehouse

explanation.ar: Degree بيتحسب بعدد الـ entity types المشاركة: Employee مع نفسه = Unary، بينما Supplier + Product + Warehouse = Ternary.

questions.question: Supplier supplies Product to Warehouse. What is the degree of this relationship?

explanation.ar: هنا عندنا 3 entities: Supplier وProduct وWarehouse، وبالتالي relationship degree = Ternary.

questions.question: A designer confuses relationship degree with cardinality. In an ERD, what should be used to decide whether the relationship is 1:1, 1:N, or M:N?

options.text: The number of entity types participating in the relationship
The number of attributes inside the entities
The number of instances of one entity that can relate to instances of another

explanation.ar: 1:1 و1:N وM:N هي Cardinality Ratios، وبتوصف عدد الـ instances المرتبطة، مش عدد الـ entity types المشاركة؛ ده اسمه Degree.

source.reference: Slides 24–25 — Relationship Degree and Cardinality Ratio

questions.question: Students can enroll in many Courses, and each Course can contain many Students. Which cardinality applies?

explanation.ar: لأن كل Student ممكن يرتبط بأكتر من Course وكل Course بأكتر من Student، فالعلاقة Many-to-Many (M:N).

questions.question: If every Employee must participate in a Works-In relationship with a Department, what participation type does Employee have?

explanation.ar: Total Participation معناها كل instance من الـ entity لازم يشارك في العلاقة؛ المادة بتدي نفس فكرة Employee works in Department.

questions.question: How is total participation shown in the ERD notation used in the course?

explanation.ar: في المادة: Double line = Total Participation، وSingle line = Partial Participation.

questions.question: A Professor may or may not supervise a Student. What participation type does this describe for Professor?

explanation.ar: بما إن مش كل Professors لازم يشاركوا في العلاقة، ده Partial Participation.

questions.question: Which statement correctly distinguishes a primary key from a foreign key in relational mapping?

options.text: A primary key is used only for multivalued attributes
A foreign key can never reference a parent entity
Both keys must always contain duplicate values
A primary key identifies rows in its table; a foreign key references a key from another related table

explanation.ar: Primary Key بيحدد كل row بشكل فريد داخل الجدول، بينما Foreign Key بيربط جدول بجدول تاني عن طريق referencing key من الجدول المرتبط.

source.reference: Slide 27 — Primary keys and Foreign keys

questions.question: After completing an ERD, a developer creates one relational table per entity but stores each entity attribute as a separate row instead of a column. What mapping rule is being violated?

options.text: Every relationship must become a weak entity
Entities should become tables and attributes should become columns
Every entity must be converted into a document

explanation.ar: الـ basic mapping rule في المادة واضح: Entity → Table وAttribute → Column. تحويل attributes إلى rows هنا تطبيق خاطئ للـ mapping.

source.reference: Slide 28 — Mapping Entity Diagrams To Tables

questions.question: A strong entity has a composite Address attribute made of HouseNo, Street, and Town. What should happen during relational mapping?

options.text: Create a weak entity only for HouseNo
Decompose Address into the atomic columns HouseNo, Street, and Town
Store all address parts as a single multivalued field

explanation.ar: المادة بتطلب decomposing composite attributes إلى atomic attributes، زي Address → HouseNo, Street, Town.

questions.question: A Surgeon can have multiple Surgery Skills. According to the mapping rule in the material, what is the correct design?

options.text: Store all skills in one non-atomic cell in Surgeon
Create a separate Sur_Skills relation containing the surgeon key and Skill
Make each skill a separate database
Remove Skill because it is multivalued

explanation.ar: Multivalued attribute بيتحول لعلاقة منفصلة تشمل Primary Key بتاع الـ strong entity + الـ multivalued attribute، زي Sur_Skills(EmpNo, Skill).

questions.question: Why is EmpNo included in the Dependent relation when mapping a weak entity?

options.text: Because the weak entity depends on the parent Employee and needs the parent's key
Because every weak entity must have no relationship to its parent
Because EmpNo is a multivalued attribute
Because weak entities cannot contain foreign keys

explanation.ar: Weak Entity بيعتمد على الـ parent، لذلك Primary Key للـ parent (EmpNo) يدخل في relation بتاع الـ weak entity للربط والتعريف.

questions.question: For the Dependent weak entity example, which composite key is proposed in the course?

explanation.ar: المادة بتقترح Composite Primary Key من EmpNo الخاص بالـ parent + D_Name الخاص بالـ dependent.

questions.question: Teacher and Course have an M:N relationship. What is the required relational mapping approach in the course?

options.text: Place every Teacher ID in one Course cell
Create an associative relation containing EmpNo and CrId
Merge Teacher and Course into one row without keys
Place every Course ID in one Teacher cell

explanation.ar: M:N ماينفعش نحلها بإضافة key واحد مباشرة لجدول الطرف التاني؛ بنعمل relation جديدة مثل ThCourses(EmpNo, CrId) غالبًا بمفتاح مركب.

questions.question: A designer places a list of many Course IDs inside a single Teacher field to represent an M:N relationship. What is the main problem highlighted by the course?

options.text: It converts the relationship into unary
It breaks atomicity; an associative relation should be created instead

explanation.ar: المادة بتوضح إن embedding multiple keys في field واحد في M:N يكسّر atomicity، والحل إنشاء relation مستقلة.

questions.question: In a 1:N Teacher-to-Course relationship, where should Teacher's primary key be placed?

options.text: In a separate table that contains no keys
As a multivalued field in Teacher
As a foreign key in the Course table on the N side
As the primary key of every table in the database

explanation.ar: في 1:N بنحط Primary Key بتاع طرف الـ 1 كـ Foreign Key في طرف الـ N؛ هنا EmpNo يروح في Course.

questions.question: For a 1:1 relationship with total participation on both sides, which implementation is allowed by the course?

options.text: Store both entities as multivalued attributes
Merge both entities into one relation or place one entity's primary key as a foreign key in the other
Always create a many-to-many associative table

explanation.ar: في 1:1 مع Total Participation من الطرفين، المادة تسمح بدمج الطرفين في relation واحدة أو وضع PK أحدهما كـ FK في الآخر.

source.reference: Slides 38–39 — Mapping 1:1, total participation both sides

questions.question: In the Employee–Salary Account example with total participation on both sides, why can the merged relation avoid null values for the paired attributes?

options.text: Because every Employee must have one Salary Account and every Salary Account must belong to one Employee
Because weak entities never allow nulls

explanation.ar: Total Participation من الطرفين معناها كل Employee مرتبط بحساب وكل حساب مرتبط بموظف، فبيانات الطرفين في الـ merged relation مطلوبة ومش optional.

questions.question: In a 1:1 relationship where Course has total participation but some Instructors have no Course, which placement shown in the course is appropriate?

options.text: Place every Course value inside Instructor as a list
Place Instructor EmpId as InsNo in Course

explanation.ar: لما Course مشارك كليًا بينما بعض Instructors ممكن مايبقاش عندهم Course، المادة بتحط EmpId الخاص بالـ Instructor كـ InsNo داخل Course.

source.reference: Slide 40 — 1:1 Total participation on one side

questions.question: A Person has a unary 1:1 'marries' relationship with another Person. How is it mapped in the course?

options.text: Add PartnerNID as a self-referencing foreign key in Person
Add multiple partner IDs in one cell
Use no key because unary relationships cannot use keys

explanation.ar: في unary 1:1، نفس الجدول بيرجع لنفسه: Person فيه PartnerNID كـ Foreign Key يشير إلى NID لشخص آخر.

questions.question: In the unary 1:N Employee supervision example, what does SuperEid represent?

options.text: A multivalued attribute containing all employees
The Eid of another Employee who acts as supervisor

explanation.ar: SuperEid هو self-referencing Foreign Key؛ قيمته Eid لموظف آخر هو الـ supervisor.

questions.question: A bill-of-materials style design lets each Medicine contain several other Medicines, and each component Medicine may appear in several mixtures. Which mapping pattern matches the course?

options.text: Add every component to one text field in Medicine
Use a separate Ingredients relation with MainDrug and CompDrug

explanation.ar: ده unary M:N؛ المادة بتحله بعلاقة منفصلة Ingredients(MainDrug, CompDrug)، وممكن تضيف attributes للعلاقة زي Dose عند الحاجة.

questions.question: A surgeon performs a particular surgery on a particular patient, and the surgery date must be stored for that combination. Where should the date be recorded according to the course?

options.text: In a separate relationship relation such as OperationData
As a multivalued attribute of every entity

explanation.ar: لأن SurDate صفة مرتبطة بالـ complex relationship نفسها بين Surgeon وSurgery وPatient، المادة بتنشئ relation منفصلة OperationData لحفظ المفاتيح مع SurDate.

questions.question: A designer stores SurDate in the Patient table even though the same patient can have multiple surgeries by different surgeons. What is the best diagnosis based on the course example?

options.text: The Patient table should be deleted
The date belongs to the multi-entity relationship and should be stored in a separate relation with the participating keys
The relationship should be changed to 1:1 regardless of reality
All keys should be replaced by multivalued attributes

explanation.ar: SurDate بتوصف حدث محدد يجمع Surgeon + Patient + Surgery، فحطها في Patient لوحده يفقد سياق الحدث. الحل relation منفصلة بمفاتيح الأطراف وتاريخ العملية.
